title: I Don't Want to Miss a Thing

cues.en: I could stay awake just to hear you breathing
cues.zh: 我願徹夜未眠，只為聽著你的呼吸
cues.text: I could stay awake just to hear you breathing

cues.en: Watch you smile while you are sleeping
cues.zh: 看著你熟睡時的微笑
cues.text: Watch you smile while you are sleeping

cues.en: While you're far away and dreaming
cues.zh: 當你在遠方甜美入夢時
cues.text: While you're far away and dreaming

cues.en: I could spend my life in this sweet surrender
cues.zh: 我願用一生沉浸在這甜蜜的臣服中
cues.text: I could spend my life in this sweet surrender

cues.en: I could stay lost in this moment forever
cues.zh: 我願永遠迷失在此刻
cues.text: I could stay lost in this moment forever

cues.en: Where every moment spent with you is a moment I treasure
cues.zh: 和你在一起的每一刻都是我珍惜的時刻
cues.text: Where every moment spent with you is a moment I treasure

cues.en: Don't wanna close my eyes, I don't wanna fall asleep
cues.zh: 我不想閉上眼睛，我不想睡著
cues.text: Don't wanna close my eyes, I don't wanna fall asleep

cues.en: 'Cause I'd miss you baby and I don't wanna miss a thing
cues.zh: 因為我會想念你，寶貝，我不想錯過任何事
cues.text: 'Cause I'd miss you baby and I don't wanna miss a thing

cues.en: 'Cause even when I dream of you the sweetest dream would never do
cues.zh: 因為即使我夢見你，最甜蜜的夢想也永遠不會
cues.text: 'Cause even when I dream of you the sweetest dream would never do

cues.en: I'd still miss you baby and I don't want to miss a thing
cues.zh: 我仍然想念你，寶貝，我不想錯過任何事情
cues.text: I'd still miss you baby and I don't want to miss a thing

cues.en: Lying close to you feeling your heart beating
cues.zh: 躺在你身邊，感覺到你的心臟在跳動
cues.text: Lying close to you feeling your heart beating

cues.en: And I'm wondering what you're dreaming
cues.zh: 我想知道你在做甚麼夢
cues.text: And I'm wondering what you're dreaming

cues.en: Wondering if it's me you're seeing
cues.zh: 不知道你看到的是不是我
cues.text: Wondering if it's me you're seeing

cues.en: Then I kiss your eyes and thank God we're together
cues.zh: 然後我親吻你的眼睛，感謝上帝我們在一起
cues.text: Then I kiss your eyes and thank God we're together

cues.en: I just wanna stay with you in this moment forever, forever and ever
cues.zh: 我只想在這一刻與你同在，永遠，永遠

cues.en: I just wanna be with you, right here with you, just like this
cues.zh: 我只想和你在一起，就像這樣
